name: listMenuOpen
label: Show list menu
description: Select to show the list menu. The list menu will be fully hidden if false.

name: hideTabs
label: Hide tabs
description: Show or hide the 'Lists' and 'My Lists' tabs. If hidden, users will not be able to save lists to 'My Lists'.

name: hideListCreation
label: Hide 'My List' creation
description: Select to prevent users from creating lists under the 'My Lists' tab.

name: configurationId
label: Configuration
description: A configuration record that defines the lists and their groupings that appear in the list menu.

name: listId
label: Selected list ID
description: The Sys ID of the list to be selected from the menu on load. Will be ignored if a Tiny ID is set. To get this value, go to the list menu configuration record, click into a category group, and then use the Sys ID of one of the list records inside.

name: listMenuCrud
label: List menu user access
description: Object used to inform the list menu of what create, read, update, or delete operations have taken place via the 'List Actions' button inside of the list.

name: tiny
label: Tiny ID
description: The tiny URL value from a tiny URL record [sys_tiny_url] corresponding to the current list. Used to prevent selection of an incorrect list in the list menu when opening a list shared with a tiny URL.

name: selectedListId
label: Selected List ID
description: ID of a list selected by a user from the menu

name: hideHighlightedValues
label: Hide Highlighted Values
description: Select to prevent highlighted values from appearing on this list.

name: hideHeader
label: Hide Header
description: Select to hide the list's header and all of its contents.

name: hideListActions
label: Hide List Actions
description: Select to prevent list declarative actions from appearing on this list.

name: hideTitle
label: Hide Title
description: Select to hide the title from appearing in the list header.

name: hideRecordCountBadge
label: Hide Record Count Badge
description: Select to hide the row count from appearing in the list header.

name: hideRefreshButton
label: Hide Refresh Button
description: Select to hide the refresh button in the list header, thus disabling the ability to refresh the list.

name: hideLastRefreshedText
label: Hide Last Refreshed Text
description: Select to hide the 'Last Refreshed' text from appearing in the list header.

name: hideMenuButton
label: Hide Menu Button
description: Select to hide the menu button (and its options within) from appearing in the list header.

name: hideOptionToSaveAs
label: Hide Option to Save As
description: Select to disable the option for users to save this list as a 'My List'.

name: hideSharingButton
label: Hide Sharing Button
description: Select to hide the sharing button from appearing in the list header.

name: hidePanelButton
label: Hide Panel Button
description: Select to hide the filter panel (and access to condition builder) from appearing in the list header.

name: hidePanelFooter
label: Hide Panel Footer
description: Select to hide the entire footer of the filter panel.

name: hidePanelRestore
label: Hide Panel Restore
description: Select to hide the button that provides the ability to restore back default filters.

name: hidePanelAdvanced
label: Hide Panel Advanced
description: Select to hide the button that provides the ability to open the advanced filter panel.

name: hidePanelConditionDelete
label: Hide Panel Condition Delete
description: Select to prevent the ability to remove filters on the list.

name: hideQuickEdit
label: Hide Quick Edit
description: Select to disable the quick edit functionality, which provides the ability to access the record in a side panel.

name: hideSelectAll
label: Hide Select All
description: Select to disable the ability to select all records in a list.

name: hideCheckboxHover
label: Hide Checkbox Hover
description: Select to prevent the checkbox hover functionality, and always display checkboxes on the list (if applicable)

name: hideCheckboxHover
label: Hide Checkbox Hover
description: Select to prevent the checkbox hover functionality, and always display checkboxes on the list (if applicable)

name: hideRowSelector
label: Hide Row Selector
description: Select to hide the row selector checkboxes.

name: hideColumnGrouping
label: Hide Column Grouping
description: Select to disable column grouping functionality.

name: hideColumnResizing
label: Hide Column Resizing
description: Select to disable the ability to drag and resize column widths.

name: hideColumnFiltering
label: Hide Column Filtering
description: Select to disable the ability to apply filters from the column heading.

name: hideColumnSorting
label: Hide Column Sorting
description: Select to disable the ability to sort a list.

name: hidePersonalization
label: Hide Personalization
description: Select to disable adding/removing and changing the order of columns in the list

name: hideDragAndDrop
label: Hide Drag and Drop
description: Select to disable the ability to drag and drop rows (recommend: do not use in conjunction with sorting)

name: hideCellFilter
label: Hide Cell Filter
description: Select to hide the cell filter popover and prevent the ability to filter cells by 'show matching' and 'filter out'.

name: hideInlineEditing
label: Hide Inline Editing
description: Select to disable inline editing functionality.

name: hideHighlightContent
label: Hide Highlight Content
description: Select to disable the ability to highlight text (typically used in conjunction with search results).

name: highlightContent
label: Highlight Content
description: Specify text that should be highlighted in the list.

name: hideLinks
label: Hide Links
description: Select to hide all links in the list; reference fields and links will render as plain text.

name: overrideWordWrapUserPref
label: Override word wrap user preference
description: Select to override the word wrap user preference, and always observe the word wrap property set here

name: wordWrap
label: Word Wrap
description: Select to wrap text in all columns.

name: maxCharacters
label: Max Characters
description: Specify the character limit to be displayed until truncating.

name: hideReferenceLinks
label: Hide Reference Links
description: Select to prevent reference fields from being clickable in the list.

name: hideEmptyStateImage
label: Hide Empty State Image
description: Select to hide the empty state image from appearing when the list has no data.

name: hidePagination
label: Hide Pagination
description: Select to hide the list pagination and all associated controls.

name: hidePages
label: Hide Pages
description: Select to hide the page numbers within the pagination.

name: hideRange
label: Hide Range
description: Select to hide the count of records appearing on the page.

name: hideRowCount
label: Hide Row Count
description: Select to hide the total count of records in the list.

name: hidePreviousPage
label: Hide Previous Page
description: Select to hide the previous page control.

name: hideFirstPage
label: Hide First Page
description: Select to hide the first page control.

name: hideLastPage
label: Hide Last Page
description: Select to hide the last page control.

name: hideNextPage
label: Hide Next Page
description: Select to hide the next page control.

name: hideRowsPerPageSelector
label: Hide Rows Per Page Selector
description: Select to prevent the ability to change the number of records to be displayed per page.

name: targetTable
label: Target Table
description: Table name that contains the lists that populate the menu

name: table
label: Table
description: Table name of a list selected from the menu

name: title
label: Title
description: Table title of a list selected from the menu

name: conditions
label: Conditions
description: The table conditions of a list selected from the menu

name: view
label: View
description: Platform defined view used to select columns

name: columns
label: Columns
description: The columns of a table to show of a list selected from the menu

name: groupByField
label: Group by column
description: The group by column to show when list is selected from the menu

name: error
label: Error
description: The information to display when an error has occurred

name: hidePersonalization
label: Hide Column Personalization
description: Select to hide column personalization.

name: landmark
label: Include in landmark keyboard shortcut
description: Landmarks define main elements on the page. When you set this property to true, the component will be included in the landmark keyboard shortcut cycling behavior, allowing users to quickly jump focus back-and-forth between the main elements on the page.
